text:
Mia (CS): @channel urgent FYI — just noticed a spike, ~3.2k redemptions in the last 30m for the spring promo. Customers are being charged unexpectedly after free-trial grants. :rotating_light:

Jason (SRE): whoa, any error patterns in the API logs?

Mia (CS): majority are promo apply calls returning 200 but billing shows them as paid. A handful of customers complaining about immediate card charges.

Olivia (Product Ops): did we accidentally flip the promo scope? I remember a config change earlier that touched scope defaults.

Mia (CS): looks like the campaign was created via the admin UI this morning by ops-team, they intended "per-customer" but UI saved it as "global". Confirmed via UI audit.

Jason (SRE): can you paste the audit entry?

Mia (CS): Audit: user=olivia, action=create_campaign, id=promo-2026-spring, params:{"code":"SPRING26","scope":"global","start":"2026-03-17T08:00:00Z","end":"2026-04-17T08:00:00Z","redemption_limit":10000}

Jason (SRE): That explains volume — global scope means any account can redeem up to the campaign limit. We're seeing automated clients redeeming many times.

Alex (Billing): if redemptions were supposed to be free but charged, we need to credit affected customers asap. Can we identify impacted invoices?

Jason (SRE): current plan: 1) disable promo code acceptance at edge (block APPLY_PROMO) 2) set campaign to paused 3) gather list of affected account_ids from redemptions table 4) hand to billing for credits. I'll run steps now.

Mia (CS): repro + quick check for CS — customers report charge even after "promo applied" in UI. Could be race where apply returned success but fulfillment didn't mark invoice as free.

Jason (SRE): looking at apply handler logs — when scope=global we don't populate "redemption_owner" and downstream billing lookup falls back to standard charge path. Patch idea: require redemption_owner for non-global scopes and treat global as explicit free-promo flag.

Jason (SRE): executing emergency block: 
```
PATCH /admin/campaigns/promo-2026-spring/pause
# result: 200 OK
```

support-bot: Campaign promo-2026-spring status changed to PAUSED by jason at 1773456812

Mia (CS): thanks. Running quick search for invoices mentioning SPRING26 in last 48h...

Alex (Billing): getting invoice matches now, ~2,980 invoice lines referencing SPRING26. I'll prepare credits and a script to reverse charges. Need CSV of account_id, invoice_id, amount.

Mia (CS): exporting redemptions: 
``
SELECT account_id, invoice_id, amount, redeemed_at FROM promo_redemptions WHERE campaign_id='promo-2026-spring' AND redeemed_at > '2026-03-17';
```

Mia (CS): exporting complete, sending to Alex via secure share.

Alex (Billing): received. I'll queue automated credits and mark invoices with note "promo misconfiguration — courtesy credit". Also drafting customer message template.

Olivia (Product Ops): internal postmortem notes: UI stored scope default as "global" after a recent change. Need guardrail: explicit confirmation for global campaigns + validation that redemption_limit and scope combos make sense (e.g., global + very high limit should warn).

Jason (SRE): technical followups I propose: 1) validation in admin-api to reject campaign if scope=global and redemption_limit > 100 2) immediate migration script to populate redemption_owner for existing redemptions where missing 3) add metric alert for sudden spike in promo redemptions.

Mia (CS): customer comms draft: short apology, explanation that they were incorrectly charged and refund/credit will be applied within 3 business days, include support contact. I'll paste draft here after Alex finalizes amounts.

Alex (Billing): credits queued — batch job started at 1773456980. ETA to finish ~45m. Will snooze billing alerts so it doesn't trigger automated follow-ups.

Jason (SRE): deployed guardrail patch to admin-api (canary) — config validation added. PR: https://git.redwood.internal/p/promo-guardrails/pull/412

Olivia (Product Ops): will follow up with training note and update runbook.

Mia (CS): closing loop: CS team to send message to impacted customers once Alex confirms credits applied. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
